title: UG72-2GFP Backbone Methods and Tools
summary: This cluster consists of various methods and tools, all sharing a common backbone, UG72-2GFP. The backbone is connected to several other methods and tools, including ABF2-2GFP-ter-URA3, AFG3-2GFP-ter-URA3, CIT1-2GFP-ter-URA3, EMC1-2GFP-ter-URA3, IRE1-2GFP-ter-URA3, NDI1-2GFP-ter-URA3, and NUC1-2GFP-ter-URA3. These methods and tools are all related to UG72-2GFP through the 'has_backbone' relation, indicating a hierarchical or modular structure.
